d.m: 替 ... 辩护；证明 ... 正当；调整版面

e.z: 光照不足则植物生长缓慢。

e.z: 在严寒的冬天,很多野生动物可能因缺乏食物而死去。

d.m: 发起；推出（新产品）；发射；使(船)下水

e.e: We were going to launch a counterattack.
e.z: 我们准备发起反攻。

e.e: The company researched the market demand and decided to launch their new product.
e.z: 这家公司调查了市场需求，决定推出新产品。

e.z: 全国人民为成功地发射了一颗新的人造卫星而欢欣鼓舞。

d.m: 维持；维修；保养；坚持；断言

e.e: It is absolutely vital that food supplies should be maintained.
e.z: 维持食物的供给是绝对必要的。

e.e: They also help us to maintain the machinery.
e.z: 他们还帮助我们维修机器。

e.e: They tell the peasants in detail how to maintain the pumps.
e.z: 他们详细地教给农民怎样保养抽水机。

d.m: 管理；经营；做成；设法对付；提供；有空

e.z: 他父亲离开的时候,由他管理公司。

e.z: 这个餐厅的成功在于它的完善经营。

e.z: 极地探险者十分小心谨慎，以便使旅途的危险性减少到最小。

e.z: 正确解决这一问题的方法是把零件的数目减至最少。

d.m: 激发(兴趣或欲望)；给与动机

e.z: 他坐在那儿什么也不干,他需要一点动力去激发他。

e.z: 犯罪似乎都来自于仇恨。

e.e: A good teacher is one who can motivate his students.
e.z: 好老师是能激励学生的老师。

e.e: This is the only means of access to the building.

e.z: 雪崩切断了进入山村的通道。

e.z: 对于守门员来说,有一双大手是很大的优势。

e.z: 理奇比你占优势，因为他会讲德语。

e.e: It is an advantage if you know how to type.
e.z: 如果你会打字,对你将有利。

e.e: To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
e.z: 中文的意思是,对于一个理性极其成熟的人来说,死亡仅仅是下一个伟大冒险。

e.e: No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't persuade his friends to give up the adventure.
e.z: 无论他怎么努力,都不能说服他的朋友们放弃冒险。

e.e: He's sailed the seven seas in search of adventure.
e.z: 他闯荡七大洋去历险。

e.e: A lot of people replied to our advertisement.
e.z: 有许多人对我们的广告作出了反应。

e.e: They inserted an advertisement in the newspaper.
e.z: 他们在这家报纸上刊登一则广告。

e.e: The wall was  covered with advertisements.

e.e: I hope we can see eye to eye about the other terms of the agency then.
e.z: 我希望到那时候我们能在代理协议的其他条款上能取得一致意见。

e.e: I got this job through an employment agency.
e.z: 我通过职业介绍所找到了这份工作。

e.e: They resigned their child to an adoption agency.
e.z: 他们把自己的孩子交给了一家收养机构。

e.e: This agenda will form the basis of our next meeting.
e.z: 本议程将成为下次会议的中心议题。

e.e: Let's go on to the next item on the agenda.
e.z: 我们讨论议程表上的下一项吧。

e.e: Let's thrash the matter over before putting it on the agenda.
e.z: 我们先把这件事仔细研究一下，再把它列入议事日程。

e.z: 汽油表指示出汽车里所剩的汽油数量。

e.z: 他每天有大量的信件要回复。

e.z: 他对该问题的分析显示出敏锐的洞察力。

e.z: 我们都同意他对政治形势的深刻分析。

e.z: 对销售额的仔细分析显示出明显的地区差别。

e.z: 节日期间投资者调查了他的祖宗。

e.z: 他不想去那里。

d.m: 圆盘；唱片；花盘；磁盘；盘形物

e.e: The moon's disk was reflected in the pond.
e.z: 似盘的月亮倒映在池塘里。

e.e: I have many disks.
e.z: 我有许多唱片。

e.e: I have no disk that may interest you.
e.z: 我没有一张唱片能引起你的兴趣。

e.e: We dislike to have anyone patronize us.
e.z: 我们不喜欢任何人对我们以恩人自居。

e.e: What do you dislike most about this movie?
e.z: 这部电影你最不喜欢什么？

e.e: I saw everything I began to dislike, in retrospect.
e.z: 我看见的一切都让我开始厌恶了，回想起来。

d.m: (形) 灰心的；沮喪的　(動) 使灰心；使沮喪

e.e: Although the basketball team lost the championship, the players didn't feel disheartened because they had tried their best.
e.z: 雖然籃球隊失去了冠軍，但球員們並沒有感到灰心，因為他們已經盡力了。

e.e: No one could dislodge them from their well-en-trenched positions.
e.z: 没人能把他们从防守严密的地方逐出。

e.e: The wind dislodged some tiles.
e.z: 风把瓦刮下来了。

e.e: They needed a bulldozer to dislodge the rock.
e.z: 他们需要一台推土机来挖出岩石。

e.e: The nurse bathed the wound with disinfectant water.
e.z: 护士用消毒水冲洗伤口。

e.e: Clean the infected area with disinfectant.
e.z: 把受感染的部分用消毒剂消毒.

e.e: Dip your injured finger in the disinfectant to soak out the poison.
e.z: 把你受伤的手指浸在消毒剂里，把毒浸泡出来。

e.e: Only after thorough disinfection can the hospital safely admit new patients.
e.z: 只有在徹底消毒之後，醫院才能安全地收治新病人。

d.m: 使 ... 沮丧；使 ... 惊愕

e.e: The enemy retreated in perfect dismay.
e.z: 敌人沮丧地退去。

e.e: To my dismay, he made the same mistakes.
e.z: 让我感到沮丧的是，他又犯了同样的错误。

e.e: He watched the burning bouse with dismay.
e.z: 他绝望地看着着火的房子。

d.m: 开除；解散；屏除；（法律）驳回

e.e: If you are late again, you will be dismissed.
e.z: 如果你再迟到，你将被解雇。

e.e: Let us dismiss and return in an hour.
e.z: 让我们先解散,一个钟头后再回来。

e.e: We should dismiss all thought of revenge.
e.z: 我们应该屏除一切报复的念头。

e.e: How did she dislocate her shoulder 4 times?
e.z: 她怎么使她的肩膀四次脱臼?

e.e: Flights have been dislocated by the fog.
e.z: 大雾将飞机的班次搅乱了。

e.e: Only an exceptionally heavy snowfall might temporarily dislocate railway service.
e.z: 只有罕见的暴雪才会暂时打乱铁路的运行。

d.m: 不感兴趣的；无私欲的；公平的；公正的

e.e: But, the mere idea of having that much money is enough to make even the most disinterested students pay attention in a social studies class.
e.z: 可是，哪怕仅仅是想到有这么一大笔钱，已经足够使那些对此最不感兴趣的学生也关注起这门社会学课程。

e.e: He is a disinterested person.
e.z: 他是一个没有私心的人。

e.e: The God makes everyone disinterested.
e.z: 上帝对每个人都是公平的！

e.e: The papers lay in a disorderly pile.
e.z: 文件乱七八糟地堆放着。

e.e: There is a disorderly heap of clothes in his room.
e.z: 他屋里有一堆乱七八糟的衣服。

e.e: The wire in the house is very disorderly.
e.z: 这屋子里的电线很乱。

e.e: His total disinterest in money puzzled his family.
e.z: 他对金钱毫无兴趣使他的家人感到迷惑不解。

e.e: Smaller-gauge ideas die off from disinterest.
e.z: 格局太小的构想会因无人关心而自然遭到淘汰。

e.e: The German side declares its complete political disinterest in these areas.
e.z: 德国边宣称它完全政治不关心在论文区域。

d.m: 混乱；杂乱；不适；失调；疾病

e.e: The meeting terminated in disorder.
e.z: 会议在混乱中结束。

e.e: This school is completely in disorder.
e.z: 这所学校完全在混乱状态当中。

e.e: The whole country of Hungary is in disorder right now.
e.z: 整个匈牙利现在陷入了一片混乱。

d.m: 免职；解雇；摒弃；不予理会

e.e: They ran in one passage about his dismissal.
e.z: 对他的免职他们又补加了一页。

e.e: He must awaken to the fact that failure means dismissal.
e.z: 他必须意识到失败了就要被免职。

e.e: I've only just heard about his dismissal.
e.z: 我刚听到他遭解雇的事。

e.e: The five experiments gave quite disparate results.
e.z: 这五次试验所获得的结果迥然不同。

e.e: Chalk and cheese are disparate substances.
e.z: 粉笔和乳酪是完全不同的东西。

e.e: With such disparate political groups, the country is in real mess.
e.z: 有着这么多根本不相同的政治集团，这个国家是真正陷入了困境。

e.e: This toy machine gun dismantles easily.
e.z: 这种玩具机关枪很容易拆卸。

e.e: He began to dismantle segregation within the armed forces.
e.z: 他着手拆除军队中的隔离。

e.e: We dismantled the house before knocking it down.
e.z: 我们在拆房前搬空家具。

d.m: 使 ... 失去方向感； 使 ... 迷惑

e.e: These methods all disorient the mind and trick the subconscious into tuning into another part of the astral.
e.z: 这些方法都会使头脑失去方向感，诱使潜意识调谐至星体层的另一部分。

e.e: Some women's tapes disorient him, but he doubts this is the reason he now hesitates to start the machine.
e.z: 有的女人的带子会让他迷惑，不过他怀疑这并不是此刻他犹豫是否启动机器的原因。

e.e: In addition to this ability, the recon will also have a smoke grenade ability, which will slow and disorient enemies caught in it, as well as making them miss their attacks.
e.z: 除了这个技能，侦查还有烟雾弹技能，这将减缓并迷惑怪物，并造成攻击丢失。

e.e: It is the task of a fighter to dispel darkness.
e.z: 驱散黑暗，这是战士的任务。

e.e: Nothing could dispel the torpidity of the indifferent audience.
e.z: 任何东西都无法驱散那些冷漠观众的困倦。

e.e: I thought,if I had caused the cloud,it was my duty to make an effort to dispel it.
e.z: 我想，如果是我引起了这块乌云，那我就该负责努力驱散它。

d.m: 派遣；发送；迅速完成；处死
急件；派遣；发送；新闻报道

e.e: A messenger was dispatched to take the news to the soldiers at the front.
e.z: 一名通讯员被派去给前线士兵送消息。

e.e: We have to ask you to dispatch the consignment immediately.
e.z: 我们得要求你立即发送该批货物。

e.e: We soon dispatched the chocolate cake.
e.z: 我们很快就吃完了那个巧克力蛋糕。

d.m: 冷静的；不带感情的；平心静气的

e.e: A journalist should be a dispassionate reporter of fact.
e.z: 记者应当是对事实作冷静报导的人

e.e: First offers, no matter how lucrative, must be met with a dispassionate eye.
e.z: 第一轮出价,不论多么有利可图,一定要冷静面对。

e.e: You should be dispassionate even if you get some success in the negotiation.
e.z: 假使在谈判中取得一些成功，你还是保持冷静为好。

e.e: Take the prescription to the dispensary and they'll make it out.
e.z: 拿这个处方到药房，他们就会给你配药了。

e.e: He bought some pills from the dispensary.
e.z: 他从学校的医务室买了一些药片。

d.m: 不是必要的；可有可无的

e.e: A garage is useful but dispensable.
e.z: 汽车房虽然有用

e.e: He repents having compensated the dispensable pesion for fear of penalty.
e.z: 他后悔因害怕处罚而补偿了不必要的养老金。

e.e: They looked on music and art lessons as dispensable.
e.z: 他们认为音乐课和美术课是可有可无的。

e.e: We were all depressed by the dismal weather.
e.z: 阴沉的天气让我们都感到压抑。

e.e: He tossed about until the appearance of the dismal London daylight, when he sprang up desperately, and walked off to his uncle's lodgings in Bury Street.
e.z: 他翻来复去，等到伦敦那阴沉的白天开始上曙光，便一骨碌爬了起来，前往柏利街他叔父的寓所。

e.e: Africa will be the highlight of an otherwise dismal year.
e.z: 非洲将是这异常凄凉的一年里的亮点。

e.e: The dispenser quickly filled the prescription for me.
e.z: 药剂师立刻照处方为我配了药。

e.e: Agatha worked as a hospital dispenser during World War One, which gave her a knowledge of poisons which was useful in her detective stories.
e.z: 阿嘉莎在一战期间做过医院药剂师，所以难怪她的小说中常会有一些关于毒药的内容。

e.e: In other words, the president, who for the first time will be a permanent presence in Brussels, may become a standing dispenser of national vetoes.
e.z: 换句话说，常务主席将首次成为布鲁塞尔一股长期存在的影响力，他也许会长期成为各国否决权的分配者。

e.e: The police dispersed the crowd.
e.z: 警方驱散群众。

e.e: The wind dispersed the cloud from the sky.
e.z: 风吹散了天上的云。

e.e: The enemy had to disperse and hide in caves.
e.z: 敌人不得不分散藏身于洞穴之中。

e.e: The condition of having been displaced.
e.z: 停职已被移位(撤换、免职)的状态

e.e: A large block of displaced rock that is caught along a fault.
e.z: 夹块，夹石绵延的地层中大块的移位岩石

e.e: Moderates have displaced the extremists on the committee.
e.z: 在委员会中，稳健派人士取代了激进派人士。

e.e: She turned away in disgust.
e.z: 她厌恶地转过脸去。

e.e: His behavior filled her with disgust.
e.z: 她对他的行为充满了厌恶。

e.e: He returned downstairs in disgust.
e.z: 他厌恶地转身下楼。

d.m: 使不高兴；使不快；使生气

e.e: His actions greatly displease me.
e.z: 他的举止令我不高兴。

e.e: Her husband's failure to notice her new hairstyle displeased her very much.
e.z: 她丈夫没注意到她的新发型，这使她大为不快。

e.e: He'd do anything rather than displease his parents.
e.z: 他无论如何也不会惹父母生气。

d.m: 可任意处理的；一次性的

e.e: The brochure is disposable after the meeting.
e.z: 会议结束后,可以任意处理这本小册子。

e.e: The advertisement is aimed at people in their 20s with high disposable incomes.
e.z: 这个广告的对象是那些二十多岁且可支配收入高的人士。

e.e: These medical cotton balls are all disposable.
e.z: 这些医用棉球仅限于一次性使用。

e.e: We placed everything at his disposal.
e.z: 我们把一切事情都交给他处理。

e.e: The disposal of rubbish is always a problem.
e.z: 垃圾的处理总是个难题。

e.e: The safe disposal of nuclear waste is a major problem.
e.z: 安全处置核废料是个大问题。

d.m: 清除；处理掉；解决；杀死；打败

e.e: I want to dispose of these old books.
e.z: 我想处理掉这些旧书。

e.e: Most complaints can be disposed of pretty quickly.
e.z: 大多数投诉可以很快地解决。

e.e: The president ruthlessly disposed of his rivals.
e.z: 这位总统无情地除掉了政敌。

e.e: The Arya Samaj did much to encourage Hindu nationalism, but it did not disparage the knowledge of the West, and it established many schools and colleges.
e.z: 雅利安社大力地鼓励了印度的民族主义，但它并没有蔑视西方的知识，也建立了很多学校和大学。

d.m: 性情；倾向；安排；处置；控制；[计算机] 配置情况

e.e: She has a calm and introverted disposition.
e.z: 她性格文静内向。

e.e: Joanna had a gentle retiring disposition.
e.z: 乔安娜性格温柔而腼腆。

e.e: The child had a placid disposition.
e.z: 这个孩子性情温和。

e.e: For a long time sol-fa is a disputable issue in the solfeggio training.
e.z: 而视唱在视唱练耳课中又占有中心地位，视唱训练中的唱名法问题一直是一个有争议的话题。

e.e: If we are to include that highly disputable clause in the text of the draft are we not to defeat our onw purpose?
e.z: 如果我们要把那个大有争议的条款写进草案的案文，我们岂不是要挫败我们自己的目的？

e.e: The couple disputed where to spend the holiday.
e.z: 夫妻俩为上哪儿度假而发生争论。

e.e: It is ridiculous to dispute about such a thing.
e.z: 为这样的事情而争论简直荒谬可笑。

e.e: "I'm not disputing what you say, matt." said Tremaine, shaking his head.
e.z: “我并不是要跟你辩驳，麦特”，屈里曼说，摇摇头。

e.e: The team has been disqualified from the competition.
e.z: 该队已经被取消参赛资格。

e.e: Her criminal record disqualifies her from serving on a jury.
e.z: 她有犯罪前科，所以不能当陪审员。

e.e: Her disquiet made us uneasy too.
e.z: 她的忧虑使我们也很不安。

e.e: The disquiet will boil over in the long run.
e.z: 这种不安情绪终有一天会爆发的。

e.e: The strength of the dollar is causing considerable disquiet on the stock exchange.
e.z: 美元表现坚挺在证券交易所中引起很大的不安。

d.m: 证明 ... 是不对的；提出 ... 的反证

e.e: In his latest book, he writes that the theory has been disproved.
e.z: 他在最近写的书里说那种理论已证明不确。

e.e: The course of a river is almost always disproved of by the source.
e.z: 河流的方向，几乎常被水源证明是不对的。

e.e: Their statement incorrect we disprove as follow.
e.z: 他们的陈述不正确，现提反对意见如下。

e.e: I will not make friends with a dishonest person.
e.z: 我决不会与不诚实的人交朋友。

e.e: Weeds tend to displace other plants.
e.z: 杂草越来越多，有取代其他植物之势。

e.e: Moderates have displaced the extremists on the committee.
e.z: 在委员会中，稳健派人士取代了激进派人士。

e.e: Please don't displace my dictionaries.
e.z: 请别动我的词典。

d.m: 声名狼藉的；见不得人的；不体面的

e.e: That dive attracts every disreputable people.
e.z: 那家下流酒吧吸引声名狼藉的人。

e.e: Francs have a rich and disreputable past.
e.z: 法郎历史悠久，声名狼藉。

e.e: I've been accused of using disreputable methods to get what I want.
e.z: 我被指控采取不正当的手段以谋取私利。

e.e: The Red Cross dispensed food and clothing to the victims.
e.z: 红十字会分发食品和衣物给受害者。

e.e: In data security, the right of users to dispense and revoke privileges for objects they own, e.g. access on programs and data sets.
e.z: 在数据安全技术中，用户对其拥有的对象行使分配和取消特权的权利，例如对程序和数据集的访问权。

e.e: Let's dispense with the formalities.
e.z: 让我们免去那些礼节吧。

e.e: She expressed her dissatisfaction with him.
e.z: 她对他表示不满。

e.e: The workman muttered his dissatisfaction.
e.z: 那个工人咕哝地抱怨着他的不满。

e.e: This statement caused immediate dissatisfaction among the reporters.
e.z: 这个讲话立刻在记者中引起了不满。

d.m: 干扰；打断；妨碍；使分裂；使破裂

e.e: Protesters tried to disrupt the meeting.
e.z: 抗议者试图扰乱会议。

e.e: The communication was disrupted by the storm.
e.z: 暴风雨使交通中断。

e.e: The bad weather has seriously disrupted supplies of food.
e.z: 恶劣的天气严重地妨碍了食品的供应。

e.e: I'm dissatisfied with the food here.
e.z: 我对这儿的饭菜不满意。

e.e: She's very dissatisfied at not getting a bonus.
e.z: 她因未能获得奖金而深感不满。

e.e: The dissatisfied customer berated the florist.
e.z: 不满意的顾客责骂花商。

e.e: The whole factory was in disruption.
e.z: 整个工厂一片混乱。

e.e: while his powerful attraction was there, disruption was out of the question.
e.z: 而他的强大吸引力所在之处，就不可能有分裂。

e.e: The incident led to the disruption of the family.
e.z: 那件事导致了家庭的破裂。

d.m: 解剖；切细；仔细研究；详细分析

e.e: In biology class we had to dissect a frog.
e.z: 上生物课时我们得解剖青蛙。

e.e: In spite of this some brave scientists did dissect bodies.
e.z: 尽管如此，一些勇敢的科学家仍坚持解剖人体。

d.m: 分裂的；破坏性的；制造混乱的

e.e: We should be alert to the potentially disruptive elements in society.
e.z: 我们应该警惕社会上潜在的破坏分子。

e.e: It is more about evolution not disruptive innovations now.
e.z: 重要的是，这是一种进化的过程，而非是破坏性的创新。

e.e: The impact of Western civilization has been highly disruptive.
e.z: 西方文化的影响具有高度的破坏性。

e.e: According to the result of the dissection, the man died from heart attack.
e.z: 根据解剖结果，此人死于心脏病发作。

e.e: Her first dissection made her change her mind about becoming a doctor.
e.z: 她进行了首次解剖后就改变了要当医生的想法。

e.e: A dissection of your argument shows several inconsistencies.
e.z: 对你论点作仔细分析后发现一些前后矛盾之处。

e.e: They use the press to disseminate right-wing views.
e.z: 他们利用报刊来传播右翼观点。

e.e: It is illegal to disseminate lies.
e.z: 散布谣言是非法的。

e.e: It is essential to widely disseminate these ideas among young people.
e.z: 在青年里面应该广泛地宣传这些思想。

e.e: In the past the voice of dissension had been quickly snuffed out.
e.z: 在过去不同的意见都很快被压制下去。

e.e: Political questions often cause dissension.
e.z: 政治问题常引起纷争。

e.e: Father's will caused much dissension among his children.
e.z: 父亲的遗嘱引起了子女之间的纷争。

e.e: This conforms to the light straight line dissemination rule.
e.z: 这符合光的直线传播规律。

e.e: Disease and coincident dissemination of virus may occur to produce an epidemic.
e.z: 本病及同时传播着的病毒即可引起一次流行。

e.e: He was fully bent upon the dissemination of Chinese culture all over the world.
e.z: 他一心致力于向全世界宣传中国文化。

e.e: I dissent from what you said.
e.z: 我不同意你所说的。

e.e: Adherence to such dissenting opinion or doctrine.
e.z: 信奉邪教坚持这种有异议的观点或学说

e.e: Single mothers and their children, who disproportionately receive food stamps, would see declines in the rates of poverty because noncash aid would be taken into account.
e.z: 不成比例地收到食品券单身妈妈及其孩子，可以见到贫困率有所下降，是因为非现金援助没有计算在内。

e.e: The means of dispersal are wind, water and animals.
e.z: 传播的媒介有风、水和动物。

e.e: In nature, seed dispersal is largely a matter of luck.
e.z: 事实上，种子的传播多半是一个机会问题。

e.e: They called for the peaceful dispersal of the demonstrators.
e.z: 他们要求示威者和平解散。

e.e: The disparity of age made it even grotesque.
e.z: 年龄的悬殊甚至使它显得可笑。

e.e: We are still seeing a disparity between the rates of pay for men and women.
e.z: 我们仍然能看到男女薪酬的不一致。
